page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.2xlarge is an ARM-based general-purpose instance powered by Alibaba Cloud's custom YiTian710 processor running at 2.75 GHz. Utilizing KVM virtualization, it provides 8 dedicated physical cores mapped to 8 vCPUs with a single thread per core, backed by 64 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a 64 MB L3 cache pool. The instance is configured with 32.0 GB of memory, delivering a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core, along with a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps. No local storage is included, requiring reliance on external block storage volumes, and there are no hardware accelerators or GPUs.

Benchmark results show balanced general-purpose execution across compute and memory workloads. The instance registers strong memory subsystem efficiency, scoring in the top 25% on the PassMark memory evaluation with uncached large-block read bandwidth reaching 100.85 GB/sec and write throughput at 40.64 GB/sec. Multi-core compute performance sits firmly in the middle tier, evidenced by a stress-ng multi-core score of 14,486.74 and 14.04 million Redis SET operations per second. However, encryption performance is notably weaker, landing in the bottom quartile on PassMark encryption tests, and medium 7B LLM prompt processing falls into the lower 10% of results.

Given its ARM64 architecture and balanced resource distribution, ecs.g8y.2xlarge offers competitive compute density and operational cost efficiency for ARM-compatible architectures without hyperthreading overhead. It is well-matched for web serving, microservice architectures, caching tiers like Redis, containerized application environments, and general enterprise application hosting that do not demand specialized x86 vector extensions or bundled high-throughput local disk IOPS.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.2xlarge is a general-purpose, ARM-based instance driven by an 8-core Alibaba YiTian710 processor clocked at 2.75 GHz. Built on KVM virtualization with dedicated single-threaded physical cores, the instance provides 32.0 GB of RAM, adhering to a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory allocation, alongside 5 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth. The instance features no local storage or GPUs. Performance testing highlights strong memory throughput that ranks in the top quartile of synthetic memory benchmarks, coupled with solid average throughput across multi-core stress tests, static web serving at 13.71 GB/sec, and in-memory key-value processing. Conversely, hardware cryptographic benchmarks show lower throughput, and large model inference proves constrained. Balancing resource density and dedicated ARM compute, ecs.g8y.2xlarge is suited for standard web infrastructure, caching tiers, container workloads, and business applications optimized for arm64 execution.
